reasoning_summary: For the single SARS-CoV-2 and general-questionnaire unit, ERBioR applies Annex II classification with regulatory minimum group 3 and reference level 3. Frequent exposure and 83.3333% acceptable compliance yield probability 1 (Baja), GRB 3, and Tolerable risk. Eight failed controls require corrective follow-up; professional assessment is not required by the reference output.
